subject: KiteHealth SOC2 architecture workshop — reschedule and evidence list
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@kitehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@kitehealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: KiteHealth SOC 2 architecture workshop

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. KiteHealth would like to move from a demo into a SOC 2 architecture workshop so our security team can validate evidence coverage (SSO, encryption at rest, audit logs, key management). Can we schedule a 60–90m working session with your architects and our security/engineering leads next week?

High-level asks from our side:
- Walk-through of private deployment options, KMS/HSM integration, and key rotation cadence
- Where audit logs are retained and how long; access controls for logs
- SSO/SAML flow and SCIM provisioning details
- A short list of artifacts you can provide after the call (e.g., config snippets, diagram, SOC2 evidence matrix)

Our availability (PST): Mon 11/23 10:00–12:00 or Tue 11/24 08:30–11:00. Let me know which works and who will be on your side.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Security Program Manager, KiteHealth
samira.khan@kitehealth.com

---
Attachment: (none)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@kitehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@kitehealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KiteHealth SOC 2 architecture workshop

Hi Samira —

Thanks — this is exactly the right next step. We can run a 75-minute architecture workshop that covers the items you listed and capture a short evidence matrix afterwards. Proposed attendees from our side: myself (security/compliance), Ben Carter (solutions architect), and Marissa Cole (product security).

Proposed times (PST):
- Mon 11/23, 10:30–11:45
- Mon 11/23, 11:00–12:15
- Tue 11/24, 09:00–10:15

If none of those match your internal leads, tell me the best single slot and we can move things around. To prepare we will surface: SOC2 artifact map, KMS/network diagram, SAML SP/SP-initiated flow, and sample audit-log retention settings. Could you confirm whether your compliance team wants raw log samples or summarized retention proofs?

I will attach a draft evidence checklist after I confirm availability — looping Ben on details.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Head, Customer Security (Redwood Inference)
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachment: (none)

Ben / Marissa —

Samira asked for 60–90m to cover SSO, KMS/HSM, and audit logs. I proposed three candidate slots. Can you confirm:
- Who will own the KMS/HSM section (Ben?)
- Marissa can handle audit-log retention and artifact packaging post-call

I’ll send the evidence matrix and a network diagram. If Ben is okay, please prep the KMS rotation notes and HSM integration summary (5–7 slides). I’ll take SSO and the SOC2 mapping.

Thanks — I want to offer Mon 11/23 11:00–12:15 as a tentative hold and switch if KiteHealth prefers another slot.

Mina

- 5m intro & objectives
- 20m KMS / key management (Redwood)

Thanks Mina — appreciate the quick reply. Our security lead has a calendar conflict for 11/23 and asked if we could move to Tue 11/24 09:00–10:15 PST. That slot looks good for our engineering lead too.

Also: can you send the evidence matrix and a KMS network diagram ahead of the call? Our compliance team prefers summarized retention proofs first, then raw samples if needed. Procurement is copied for contract alignment after the technical walkthrough.

Samira
